title: Combo GM Windshield Washer Pump Repair Kit w/ 90° & Straight Fitting Plates
description_markdown: table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; } th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; } th { background-color: #f2f2f2; text-align: left; } Product Description Need to add or replace a coolant recovery system to your engine? This popular universal kit is made in the USA and comes with all the necessary pieces for an easy installation, including a durable accumulator bottle, cap, hang basket with mount holes, overflow tube, tube clamps, washers and mounting clips. Thousands of satisfied customers have found this useful for adding or modifying recovery systems on cars and trucks, boats, motor homes, and potentially anything else that overflows liquid coolant that needs to be returned to the cooling system. Great for modification or replacement - this engine coolant recovery tank kit catches and returns coolant on cars, trucks, boats, motor homes and many other applications Made in USA - durable accumulator bottle is designed and manufactured with thicker and longer-lasting plastic than cheap competitor models All necessary equipment included - accumulator bottle, cap, hang basket with mount holes, overflow tube, tube clamps, washers and mounting clips Multiple shapes and sizes available - similar designs with different reservoir dimensions available for fitting into particular spaces or making room for other components Product Specifications Cable Material: HDPE Cap Included: Yes Color/Finish: Clear Height: 7.75 in Holding Tank Capacity: 1 Quart Holding Tank Color: White Holding Tank Material: HDPE Hose Color: Clear Hose Length: 4 ft Inside Diameter: 8 mm Length: 6.5 in Mounting Bracket Included: Yes Mounting Hardware Included: Yes Mounting Hole Quantity: 2 Package Contents: (1) Accumulator Bottle; (1) Cap; (1) Hang Basket With Mount Holes; (1) Overflow Tube; (2) Tube Clamps; (2) Washers; (2) Tube Clips; (4) Mounting Screws Package Quantity: 1 Packaging Type: Box Reservoir Cap Included: Yes Shape: Square Universal Or Specific Fit: Universal
